notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.8
notes.content:
🎉 Greetings, aquatic overlords and tank decorators!
It’s Axbert, back again with another round of fixes, tweaks, and features that may or may not make your fish smarter than me (spoiler: probably not).


🐠 Fish & Friends Updates

✨ Neon Fish Colors Added

Axbert refuses to tell you how to get them or what the colors are.
But they’re bright, flashy, and very possibly judging your taste in decor.
Good luck, you sneaky fish wrangler.


🪼 Jellyfish Now Fits in Size 1 Tanks or Bigger
Our chonky squishy friend was previously treating your tiny tanks like it owned the place.
Now it’s more considerate—still a giant jelly blob, just slightly less… terrifying.

🎨 Dot Colour Indicator in Fish List and Info Menus
Because sometimes reading words is hard, so now you get a tiny colored dot.
Instant recognition. Instant class. Instant “why didn’t we do this sooner?”

🐟 Grey Tang is No Longer Darker Than Black Tang
The universe briefly fell into chaos.
It’s fixed. Grey is grey. Black is black. No more existential crises at your aquarium.

📝 Fish Name Text Scaling Fixed
Name your fish “Sir Reginald von Fluffypaws the Third”.
It will now actually fit in the name field. Because apparently long names matter.


🖥️ Menus, Loading & Tank Navigation

⏳ Loading Screen Added to Fish List
I still couldn’t figure out smooth dynamic loading… but now you get a loading screen to stare at while the magic happens.
Feel free to hum. Or cry. Your choice.

🖤 Current Tank Greyed Out in Tank Switch Menu
You don’t have to guess which tank you’re in anymore.
Unless you want to. Then ignore it. But it’s there.


🔮 Magic, Fortune & Steam

🎶 Free Fortune Audio Fixed
Apparently magic sounds cost money before.
Not anymore! We've optimized the mana flow so free users now get their fancy magic noises without needing a loan.

☁️ Steam Cloud Saves Now Actually Sync Across Operating Systems
Big thanks to ToraOkami for testing on Windows & Steam Deck.
Now Linux, Windows, and whatever else can share tanks like civilized aquatic nations.

That’s it for 1.0.8!
Whether you’re naming a ridiculously long fish, staring at a loading screen, or watching a jellyfish take up half your tank—remember: I’m always here, judging your decor choices.

Axbert 🦎
Jellyfish wrangler. Menu magician. Pear wiggler participant.

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.7b
notes.content:
Discovered weeks ago. Fixed one hour after launch. Whoops. Written by Axbert 🦎

🫣 So here’s the deal…
Massive shoutout to Filthy on the Steam forums for catching this sneaky bug weeks ago—and a massive oops to the dev, who only saw the post today, right after launching 1.0.7.

Yes, today. Yes, I’m serious. Timing? Impeccable. Forum awareness? …Room for growth.

🐛 Bug Fixes

🐟 Tank Transfer Button Text Fixed (Fish List Menu)
In the fish list menu, tank transfer buttons showed:
4 5 6 | 4 5 6
But the second 4, 5, and 6 were actually sending fish to 7, 8, and 9. They just… didn’t feel like saying so.

It was a visual bug only, but let’s be real—it looked like a glitch straight out of a tank-based fever dream.

To be honest, I didn’t expect anyone to actually use the 7th, 8th, and 9th tanks.
But Filthy did.
Filthy dared.
And now the truth has been set free. Thanks again, you tank titan.

That’s all for this mini-fix!

Until next bug,
Axbert 🦎
Forum lurker. Button snitch. I’ll make sure the dev reads the forums.

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.7
notes.content:
🎉 Happy “I added way too much in one patch” Day!
It’s me, Axbert, back with a giant wriggly bundle of new features, seasonal sparkles, and UI fixes I definitely told the dev about weeks ago but he just now got around to.


Let’s get tankin’:

🪼 A Jellyfish Has Appeared!
It wiggles. It glows.
It probably has no idea where it is, and honestly? Same.
Now available to lovingly trap inside your tank, this new jellyfish brings exactly 0 brain cells and 100% vibes.
Do not boop the bell.
[img src="https://bondio.li/images/steam/1.0.7-Jellyfish.png"]
🍁 Canada Day Decor – Maple Leaf
Available July 1 – July 14 Annually

Nothing says “Canada” like a leaf gently drifting into a pond… followed by twelve more.
Add this majestic maple leaf decor to your tank and pretend it’s October and you’re building a moody fall pond full of regrets and dead leaves.
Bonus points if your fish apologize after bumping into it.

⭐ Independence Day Decor – Star
Available July 4 – July 18 Annually

It’s a star. It can be red. It can be white. It can be blue. It’s everything your fireworks-loving heart could ever want.
Plant it proudly in your tank and hear your betta whisper, “’Murica” every time it swims by.
Don’t care about America? No problem—make a night sky with 'em and pretend it’s just space decor.
(Axbert will still judge you. Silently.)


🐧 Linux Love (and Scroll Justice)

✅ Scroll Inversion is Now Automatic on Linux!
You no longer have to scroll backwards to zoom in like some kind of cursed crab.
We detect your Linux-ness and adjust accordingly—because you matter.

🛠️ Bonus: Manual Scroll Inversion Toggle
Prefer to scroll wrong anyway? That’s between you and your tank.
Now you can toggle it. No judgment.
(Lots of judgment.)

📸 Screenshot Button!
Capture your beautifully chaotic fish tank with a simple click!
Saved right to your Pictures/Screenshots folder so you can hoard tank photos like it’s a Pinterest board you’ll never show anyone.


🐠 Fish List Overhaul!

⚡ Loading Is Now Spread Across Frames
The fish list no longer causes your game to choke like a goldfish trying to eat a marble.
It’s fast. It’s smooth. It’s deliciously responsive.

📑 Sort Fish by:
    

Name


Colour


Personality


Hat


Rarity


Value


Level


It’s like Excel, but wetter.

🧾 Selling Fish Now Counts for Achievements
We finally wired up the stat counter.
Go sell your fish. Farm those sweet, sweet Steam achievements. Live your capitalist dreams.

🔻 Fixed Last Row Being Cut Off
The final row in the fish list was getting awkwardly squished like it was grounded.
Now it’s free to stretch its fins in full visible glory.


📏 UI Clipping in Sub-16:9 Aspect Ratios – DEEPLY FIXED

Oh boy.
Turns out the UI was never actually built for anything but plain ol’ 16:9.
But the dev—who uses an ultrawide monitor every single day—just now noticed it.
Amazing. Truly groundbreaking.

If your screen is extra thicc:
Your UI will no longer freak out, cut itself off, or do an interpretive dance.
Everything should display cleanly now, even if your monitor is 12 feet wide and shaped like a baguette.

That’s all for 1.0.7!
I’ll be over here, sipping maple syrup through a sparkler while taking jellyfish selfies and scrolling like a first-class citizen.

Until next time,
Axbert 🦎
Jellyfish wrangler. UI shame dealer. Patriotic leaf collector.

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.6b
notes.content:
🐟 Surprise! It’s me again.
Didn’t I just finish telling you about 1.0.6?
Yes. Yes I did. But apparently someone (not naming names, but it rhymes with “developer”) decided he wasn’t quite done today. Classic.

🖼️ New(ish) Stuff

📏 You Can Resize the Window Now
In windowed mode, you can now grab those edges and resize the game like a responsible adult.
No more fixed dimensions, no more yelling. Unless you want to yell. That’s your journey.

👻 Removed Herobrine.
(Again. He keeps sneaking back in.)

That’s it!
Short, sweet, and slightly chaotic—just the way I like my updates.
If you see me again later today… pretend you didn’t.

– Axbert 🦎
Window wrangler. Patch repeater. Herobrine remover.

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.6
notes.content:
🕶️ Hello again, Tank Lovers!
It’s your jazzy buddy Axbert, sliding in to drop a smooth little update full of mystery, sparkle, and absolutely no sandwiches pretending to be fish. Nope. Nothing like that in here. Definitely not.

Anyway! Let’s check out what’s new in version 1.0.6:

💫 New Stuff! Just Added! Totally Fresh!

🧜‍♂️ Seahorses Have Arrived!
That’s right—seahorses are now a thing!
They’re here, they’re weird, and they swim like pipe cleaners caught in a current.
Put them in your tank. Love them. Pretend they’re dragons.

💎 Crystal Decorations – Four Sizes of Sparkly, Tank-Friendly Awesomeness!
We’ve added brand-new crystal decor to the game!
Four sizes, ranging from “hmm that’s neat” to “wow that’s borderline geological.”
Decorate responsibly. Or irresponsibly. I’m not your boss.

🗓️ Limited-Time Fish Appearances!
Support for seasonal fish has been added!
One will show up in the shop around the end of July.
What is it? Why is it? Should you be afraid?
No comment. Don’t ask again.

🎶 New Song: “Aquarium on the Jazz”
Nobody asked for it.
I made it anyway.
It’s jazzy, it’s moody, it pairs well with reflective fish and neon lights.

🎣 A New Ultra-Rare “Catch” in the Fishing Minigame
Something has been added to the waters.
It is not a fish.
It is not exciting.
It is not influenced by your luck stat.
In fact, luck means absolutely nothing here.
It might not even exist.
Or maybe it does.
Either way, you won’t find it. Probably. Maybe.

🛠️ Bug Fixes & Improvements

🍣 Fixed Achievement Tracking for “Seaweed, make sushi”
The seaweed counter wasn’t resetting when counting the seaweed, so you'd unlock it 5 minutes after adding one piece of seaweed.
Now it resets like a good little variable. For those of you who got this achievement accidentally, I'll let you keep it. 🍱

🐡 Koi Now Catchable in Pond Fishing
The koi union refused to be caught before.
So I brought them in for a stern HR meeting.
They’ve agreed to participate in the fishing minigame now.
(After several donuts and a mild threat to revoke their decorative privileges.)

👀 Removed Unused Outline Scripts from Fish Eyes & Mouths
These were doing a whole lotta nothing and hogging space.
Gone. Your tank runs smoother now and your fish blink 7% more confidently.

🎩 Fixed Hat Outlines Getting Clipped by Selection Indicator
Your stylish fish friends were suffering from hat embarrassment.
We’ve upgraded the outline system so hats now render in all their fabulous glory, even when selected.

Removed Herobrine.

That’s it for now, friends.
Whether you’re jazzing up a cozy tank, chasing the unknown in the fishing minigame, or just wondering when a strange fish will show up in the shop... I’ll be here. Watching. Waiting. Vibing.

Until next time,
Axbert 🦎
Crystal curator. Mystery gatekeeper. HR specialist, Jazz engineer.

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.5
notes.content:
🎉 Hello again, aquascapers and fish whisperers!

It’s me, Axbert, and I’ve been swimming laps around the dev's patch notes, fixing bugs, sipping iced seaweed tea, and writing this update just for you.
Let’s cannonball into version 1.0.5—there’s a lot to love, a lot to laugh at, and yes… a little something for the luxurious among you.

🐛 Bug Fixes & Fin-Fluffing

🎣 Fixed UI Cutoff in Fishing Minigame (Wiiiiiide Relief)
If you’re playing on a gloriously wide monitor, you might’ve noticed the fishing minigame rudely hiding critical UI behind some black bars.
That’s now been reined in. You can see all your buttons again. Cast away with confidence!

🌙 Smooth Wake-Ups for Sleepy Fish
Before: Sleep particles just vanished like bad vibes.
Now: They gently fade out when your fish wake up—because nobody wants a sudden awakening!

🛠️ Quality-of-Life, Tank Tech & Tiny Joys

🔍 Zoom & Pan Controls!
You can now zoom in and out of your tank using the scroll wheel (or up/down on a D-pad), and it zooms right into wherever your cursor is pointing.
Oh, and you can pan around the same way. Go ahead. Frame your tank like a gallery piece. Get cinematic. 🎥✨

⚠️ “Too Big” Message Clarified (With Words!)
Until now, when you tried to place an item or fish that was too big for your tank, you got… an icon of a giant tree or whale.
Which was funny! But confusing.
Now, we’ve harnessed the power of WORDS to give you a polite nudge:
“Too big.”
That’s it. That’s the message. Use it wisely. 🐋🌳💬

🍽️ Adult Fish Chill Out at Mealtime
Adult fish now only have a 25% chance to go for food when it drops in.
That means your baby fish have a better shot at snacking and growing up without being out-competed by their older tank-mates.
Small fish, big dreams! 💫🐠

❄️ Ice Water Fancyfied

❄️ Ice Water, But Make It Premium
Our ice water material has been upgraded to have more animated flow, because come on—
If you’re putting your fish in ice, it better look like it came from a fancy glacier or the inside of a million-dollar watch.
We’re talking high-thread-count, crystal-chilled, ultra-bougie iceberg vibes.
Only the chillest for your gill friends. 🧊💎⏱️

🎁 New Unlockable Decor

🪙 Diver Helmet
Breed a black angelfish to unlock this classic deep-sea accessory!
Perfect for mystery. Perfect for storytelling. Also makes your tank 47% more “lost treasure adventure” themed.

That’s all for now, tank champions!
Thank you for continuing to fill your tanks with love, color, and sometimes very large misunderstood icons.
Until next time, I’ll be floating somewhere near a snack pile and a glittery tank of goldfish.

Stay splashy,
Axbert 🦎
Zoom controller. Tooltip translator. Ice-themed fashion consultant.

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.4
notes.content:
💥 Blub blub! It’s your pal Axbert, back with another tank-shaking update!

I just swam out of the dev’s changelog folder (yes, it’s soggy), and I’ve got some fresh fixes and splashy new content to tell you about! So grab your fish flakes and settle in, because Update 1.0.4 is LIVE!

🐛 Bug Fixes

✔️ Decor XP Bug Squashed!
Okay, this one was a real slippery little eel:
Decor items with tiny XP boosts (less than 1.0) weren’t giving you any XP.
Like, zero. Zip. Nada. You could put ten 0.1 XP items in your tank and still get... NOTHING.
Turns out the math was rounding down so hard it forgot how numbers work.
But I gave the dev a calculator and a firm splashing – now your decor is finally pulling its weight!

No more XP ghosting! Let the tiniest trinkets help your fish grow into majestic splash-lords! 🐠📈

🎩 New Stuff!

🎉 ¡Sombrero Time!
That’s right! There’s a new hat in the random fish fashion pool, and it’s a sombrero!
Fish may now randomly don this fabulous festive headgear while swimming stylishly about.
But wait, there’s more...

🦆 Limited-Time Sombrero Duck!!
Now through the end of the month, keep an eye out for the rubber duck wearing a sombrero in the decor shop – it's a limited-time decor item to spice up your tank!
After that, it’ll go back into the vault until Cinco de Mayo next year.
Collect it while it’s hot (and before the duck flies off into the sunset)! 🌮🎶

🌸 New Unlockable Decor – Sea Anemone!
A beautiful, wobbly sea anemone is now available to unlock!
How? Just breed a light orange clownfish – yep, the cute wiggly ones – and the anemone will appear in your decor catalog!
It’s the perfect home for your little clowny fish friends. 🧡🎪

That’s all for now, my fish-tankin’ champions!
Decorate smarter, collect harder, and remember: even the tiniest item can now make a BIG splash.

Catch ya next update – I’ll be here... floating near the snack machine. 😎🫧

With bubbly love,
Axbert 🦎
Decor detective. Hat curator. Math enforcer.

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.3
notes.content:
🎉 Heya fishy friends!! It’s me, Axbert – your sparkly, snack-loving axolotl buddy – and today’s a super special day...

🥳 HAPPY LAUNCH DAY!! 🎉
The tanks are clean, the fish are floppin’, and the decorations are looking chef’s kiss! I’m so excited to finally welcome you into our cozy, bubbly little world. Whether you're here to breed beautiful fish, decorate to your heart’s content, or just vibe with the tank lights turned to maximum sparkle mode—we're SO glad you're here.

Now, let’s swim over to the patchy part of our underwater party...
🛠️ Patch 1.0.3 – Achievement Bubbles Unstuck!

So here’s the scoop from the bottom of the tank:
Steam Achievements weren’t bubbling up properly in the release build. They worked perfectly in the editor—where everything’s sunshine and snax—but in the wild? Nope. Flatline. It was like trying to throw a party with no balloons! 🎈😱

Turns out our beloved dev forgot to configure the Steam package correctly for the build. Whoopsie-daisy! I gave them a stern splash and a soggy note that said “Test your builds, silly!” 💦

But the fix is in, and now:
✅ What’s Fixed:


🐟 Steam Achievements now properly unlock in the full release build!
    Already met the requirements? Just boot up the game and pop, they should appear like magic!

⚠️ One More Thing:

Some achievements or stats that should have unlocked before this patch might not retroactively update.
Our dev is super sorry about that! 😔💌
They were just so excited for launch, they missed a tiny—but very splashy—detail. You may need to meet the criteria again to unlock a few things. We know that’s a bit of a bummer, and we’re really grateful for your patience and support. ❤️🐠

Thanks for making launch day fin-tastic!
Keep collecting, decorating, and fish-loving—I'll be watching with my googly eyes and occasional snack breaks.

Bloopily yours,
Axbert 🦎
Tutorial overlord. Achievement inspector. Bubble party planner.
